title: ChicekRuntimeConfig
description: Remote runtime configuration accepted by @chicek/browser-observability. Every field is closed and cannot be used to weaken the privacy baseline (no session replay by default, no insecure transport, no arbitrary endpoints).

rumSite.description: Bare host[:port] of the OpenObserve RUM ingestion endpoint the SDK will call over HTTPS, e.g. 'localhost:8443'. Never a full URL: no scheme, path, query, credentials, or whitespace, so an insecure 'http://' (or any other) scheme can never be smuggled in through this field.

rumClientToken.description: OpenObserve RUM ingestion token. This is a browser-exposed client credential, not an admin/root credential, and carries no search/management authority.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema the payload was authored against.

configVersion.description: Operational runtime config version shown in status snapshots.

enabled.description: Global on/off switch for the entire observability package.

engaged.description: When true, the SDK must stop all data collection immediately, regardless of other fields.

privacyProfile.description: Closed set of privacy profiles. Neither profile permits body, credential, cookie, or session-token capture. Only 'strict' has distinct behavior; 'balanced' is a deprecated legacy alias the SDK normalizes to 'strict' and must not be used in new configs.

errorSampleRate.description: Deprecated legacy no-op: the adapter never applies a separate error sample rate (only sessionSampleRate is forwarded). Accepted for backward compatibility only; do not send in new configs.

rum.description: Connection fields are only required when the top-level `enabled` flag is true (see the root-level `allOf`/`if`/`then` below); a disabled config must be expressible without real or fake connection fields.

enabled.description: Session replay is off by default and cannot be enabled through this schema version.

sensitiveRoutes.description: Canonical field. Routes excluded/redacted from telemetry capture. Send exactly one of sensitiveRoutes or the deprecated legacy alias allowedRoutes, never both.

allowedRoutes.description: Deprecated legacy alias for sensitiveRoutes (the name was always misleading: these routes are excluded/redacted, not allowed). Accepted for backward compatibility only; do not send in new configs, and never send together with sensitiveRoutes.

allowedSelectors.description: Deprecated legacy no-op: Session Replay is disabled and unsupported, so there is no DOM masking/blocking behavior left for this field to control. Accepted for backward compatibility only; do not send in new configs.

allOf.description: Exactly one of the canonical field or its legacy alias must be present.
Fail-closed if both the canonical field and the legacy alias are sent together.
